DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご用件を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. May I ask what brings you here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この通知の締切が明日だと思い、書類を全部そろえずに来てしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 締切が翌日だと思い不足書類のあるまま来庁したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought the deadline on this notice was tomorrow, so I came without getting all the documents together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you came to the municipal office with some documents missing because you thought the deadline was the next day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 明日という日付はどこに書いてありますか。通知本文を一緒に見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where does it say tomorrow? Please show me the text of the notice so we can look at it together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 封筒に私が書いた日付です。休みの日に提出するつもりで書いたのを忘れていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 封筒の日付は自分の提出予定であり通知の締切と取り違えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is a date I wrote on the envelope myself. I had forgotten that I wrote it because I planned to submit the documents on my day off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the date on the envelope was your own planned submission date and that you mistook it for the notice's deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの通知では締切は来週です。添付書類の一覧がありますが、今日はどれをお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: According to this notice, the deadline is next week. There is a list of documents to attach. Which ones have you brought today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 申請書と本人確認の書類はあります。勤務先からの証明がまだ見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持参した二種類の書類と不足する勤務先の証明を区別して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the application form and my identification documents. I still cannot find the certificate from my employer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese which two types of documents you brought and distinguish them from the missing certificate from your employer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その証明の項目については担当が確認します。紛失したのか、まだ発行されていないのか分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check the requirement for that certificate. Do you know whether you lost it or it has not been issued yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社へ頼んだか覚えていません。まず会社に確認するので、今日の提出は待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発行を依頼したか会社に確認するため今日の提出を見送ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not remember whether I asked my company for it. I will check with the company first, so I would like to hold off on submitting today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will not submit today because you need to check with your company whether you requested the certificate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。期限に間に合わない見込みになった場合は、この通知の問い合わせ先へ早めに相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. If it looks as though you will not meet the deadline, please contact the inquiry office listed on this notice as soon as possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社の発行状況を確認します。そろわない場合は来週まで待たず、通知の担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発行状況を調べ期限に間に合わない場合は担当へ早めに相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the status of the certificate with my company. If I cannot get everything together, I will contact the person responsible for this notice without waiting until next week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will check the certificate's issuance status and contact the person in charge early if you cannot meet the deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通知とお持ちの書類をお返しします。準備の際にまたご相談ください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are your notice and the documents you brought. Please consult us again if you need help preparing them. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付でお手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything I can help you with at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 体温の欄に百と書きました。家の体温計の数字ですが、そのままでいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海外の体温計の百という表示を問診の体温欄に書いてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote one hundred in the body temperature field. That is the number on my thermometer at home. Is it all right to leave it as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may write the reading of one hundred from a thermometer bought overseas in the temperature field on the medical questionnaire.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 単位は何と表示されていますか。体温計の写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: What unit is shown on it? Do you have a photo of the thermometer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 海外で買った物です。数字の横に小さいFがありますが、意味を知りませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 海外購入の機器で数字横のFの意味を知らなかったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I bought it overseas. There is a small F beside the number, but I did not know what it meant.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you bought the device overseas and did not know what the F beside the number meant.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 温度の単位を確認する必要があります。機器の表示を医療職へ見せましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to check the temperature unit. Let us show the device's display to a medical professional.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 摂氏だと思って百と書いたので、確かな摂氏の数値として扱わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 摂氏と誤解して記入したため確定した摂氏値として扱わないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I wrote one hundred because I thought it was Celsius, so please do not treat it as a confirmed temperature in Celsius.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you entered the number because you misunderstood it as Celsius, and ask that it not be treated as a confirmed Celsius reading.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記入の事情を担当へ伝えます。その写真はいつ測った時のものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will explain to the person in charge how you came to enter that number. When was the measurement in that photo taken?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日の朝七時です。昨日の写真もありますが、それは別の時刻です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真は当日朝七時で昨日の写真とは別だと測定時点を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: At seven this morning. I also have a photo from yesterday, but that was taken at a different time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the photo shows the measurement at seven this morning, distinguishing it from the photo taken yesterday.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真を測定時刻ごとに分けてください。こちらで数値を推測して書き直すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please separate the photos by the time of measurement. We will not guess the value and rewrite it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日七時の写真を先に見せます。単位を確認し、自分で換算した数字に書き換えず医療職へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時刻別の表示写真で単位を医療職へ確認し自己換算で訂正しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the photo from seven today first. I will ask a medical professional to check the unit rather than replacing the entry with a number I converted myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will use photos of the display arranged by measurement time to check the unit with a medical professional, without correcting the entry through your own conversion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 単位と時刻の確認が必要と引き継ぎます。写真はお手元にお持ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass on that the unit and time need to be checked. Please keep the photos with you. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知人からのメールについて相談したいです。印刷しましたが、全部の文が入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相談用に印刷した知人のメールに全文が入っていないと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to ask about an email from someone I know. I printed it, but the printout does not include all the text.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the email from an acquaintance that you printed for your consultation does not include the full text.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 印刷した部分は元のメールのどの箇所ですか。省略した所が分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which part of the original email did you print? Can you tell which parts were left out?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 画面に見えた後半だけです。前の文は印刷のとき画面の上に隠れていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 印刷は画面に見えた後半だけで前半が隠れていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only the latter half that was visible on the screen. The earlier text was hidden above the screen when I printed it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you printed only the latter half visible on the screen and that the first half was hidden above it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 前後も確認したいので、元のメールを保持したまま見せてください。余白の文字は何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I would like to check the surrounding text too, so please show me the original email without altering it. What is the writing in the margin?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私が感想を書いたメモです。相手が送った言葉ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 余白の追記は本人の感想で相手の発言ではないと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Those are notes I wrote about how I felt. They are not words the other person sent me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the notes in the margin are your own impressions, distinguishing them from what the other person said.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相手の本文とご自身の感想を別に伺います。元のメールを表示できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will ask you separately about the sender's text and your own impressions. Can you display the original email?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 携帯で最初から表示できます。書いた感想の紙とは別に見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 携帯で元メールの最初から表示し感想の紙と分けて見せると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can show it from the beginning on my phone. I will show it separately from the paper with my impressions written on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will display the original email from the beginning on your phone, separately from the paper with your impressions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 日時と送信元の表示も、分かる範囲で確認します。相手の意図は表示だけでは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will also check the displayed date, time, and sender as far as possible. We will not determine the sender's intentions from the display alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 元の全文と日時を見せます。後半の印刷だけで全部だと言わず、私の感想も区別して説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元の全文と送信日時を示し部分印刷と本人の感想を分けて説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the full original text and its date and time. I will explain which part is my own impression, without presenting the printout of the latter half as the whole email.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will show the full original email and the sending date and time, distinguishing the partial printout from your own impressions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。順に内容を伺います。ご自身で画面を開いてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will hear the details in order. Please open the screen yourself and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。発送で何かご希望がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Is there anything you would like to request about shipping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人へ私から贈物を送ります。この会社の箱だと、会社からの贈物と思われませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社名の印刷箱で私費の贈物を送ると会社の贈物に見えるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending a gift to a friend from myself. If I use this company box, will my friend think the gift is from the company?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether sending a gift paid for personally in a box printed with a company name might make it look like a gift from that company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱の印刷と差出人欄は別です。差出人にはどなたの情報を書く予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The printing on the box is separate from the sender field. Whose information are you planning to enter as the sender?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社の箱なので会社名を書こうと思いました。でも代金は自分で払っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱に合わせ差出人も会社名にしようとしたが私費と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Since it is a company box, I was going to write the company name. But I am paying for it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you were going to put the company name as the sender to match the box, but that you are paying personally.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実際の差出人と返送先が分かるようご案内します。会社が発送を引き受けているのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will explain how to make the actual sender and return address clear. Is the company handling the shipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ。会社は関係ありません。自分の名前と住所で送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社は発送に関与せず本人名と住所で送りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. The company is not involved. I would like to send it under my own name and address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the company is not involved in the shipment and that you want to use your own name and address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その情報で準備しましょう。箱に前の送り状や会社宛てのラベルが残っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us prepare it with that information. Are there any old shipping labels or labels addressed to the company left on the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社宛ての古いラベルがあります。これを外して新しい宛先だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧会社宛ラベルを外して今回の宛先だけ残すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is an old label addressed to the company. I will remove it and leave only the new destination label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will remove the old label addressed to the company and leave only the current destination label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 箱の広告まで差出人と同じものとして扱う必要はありませんが、宛先表示は一つにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: You do not have to treat the advertising on the box as identifying the sender, but please make sure only one destination is displayed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 古いラベルを外しました。私の差出情報と友人の宛先で送り、贈物の手紙にも自分の名前を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の差出情報と友人の宛先で準備し手紙にも自分の名前を書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have removed the old label. I will send it with my sender information and my friend's destination address, and I will put my own name in the letter accompanying the gift too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will use your own sender details and your friend's delivery address, and write your own name in the letter as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 宛先と差出情報を確認して受付します。こちらへお載せください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check the destination and sender information and accept the parcel. Please place it here. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日の連絡先変更の控えに、住所しか書いてありません。電話番号も変更されたか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日の連絡先変更控えに住所だけ記載され電話番号の受付状態を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The copy I received for yesterday's change of contact information only lists my address. I would like to know whether my phone number was changed too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the copy for yesterday's change of contact information only lists the address and that you want to check whether the phone number change was processed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 控えとご本人の確認をしたうえで、昨日の受付内容を調べます。申込書は二項目とも書きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: After checking your copy and verifying your identity, I will look up what was processed yesterday. Did you fill in both items on the application form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 住所の欄は書きましたが、電話番号は窓口で口頭で言っただけでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所は記入したが電話番号は口頭で伝えただけだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I filled in the address field, but I only gave my phone number verbally at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you filled in your address but only gave your phone number verbally.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付記録には住所変更だけがあります。電話番号は別に確認して手続きする必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The processing record only shows an address change. We need to check the phone number separately and complete the procedure for it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、電話番号の変更を追加で相談したいです。昨日の住所変更を取り消す必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話番号変更を追加するため住所変更の取消しが必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I would like to ask about adding a phone number change. Do I need to cancel yesterday's address change?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you need to cancel the address change in order to add a phone number change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住所変更を取り消す必要はありません。新しい番号の確認に進みますので、こちらの案内をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is no need to cancel the address change. We will proceed with checking the new number, so please read these instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しい番号を見せます。数字を聞き間違えないよう、私の携帯の表示で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新番号の聞き間違いを防ぐため携帯の番号表示で確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will show you the new number. Please check it on my phone's display so that none of the digits are misheard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the new number to be checked on your phone's display to prevent any digits from being misheard.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示と申込内容を照合します。手続き後の反映や確認方法は、担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will compare the display with the application details. The person in charge will explain when the change takes effect and how to check it after the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住所変更はそのままにして、電話番号だけ追加します。反映の確認方法も担当に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所変更を維持して電話番号のみ追加し反映の確認方法を担当へ尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will leave the address change as it is and add only the phone number change. I will also ask the person in charge how to check that it has taken effect.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will keep the address change and add only the phone number change, and ask the person in charge how to check that it has taken effect.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。受付記録を添えて担当へ引き継ぎます。こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will pass this on to the person in charge with the processing record. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。商品で何かお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Do you have a question about a product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この缶を買いたいです。上の輪を引けば開きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 選んだ缶を上部の輪で開けられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to buy this can. Can I open it by pulling the ring on top?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the can you selected can be opened using a ring on top.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この缶には輪がありません。開けるには缶切りが必要と表示されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This can does not have a ring. The label says you need a can opener to open it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家に缶切りはないです。全部の缶に輪があると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 缶切りを持たずすべての缶に開封輪があると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not have a can opener at home. I thought every can had a pull ring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you do not own a can opener and thought all cans had a pull ring.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ売場でも開封方式は商品ごとに違います。袋入りの候補も見ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even in the same section, the way to open the packaging differs by product. Would you like to look at some options in pouches too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見たいです。同じ味でなくてもいいので、道具なしで開けられる物を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同味に限定せず道具なしで開けられる袋入り候補を見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I would. It does not have to be the same flavor; I will choose something I can open without tools.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you would like to see pouch options that open without tools and that they do not have to be the same flavor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらは切り口から開ける袋です。中身と調理の表示も別にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This pouch opens from the notch. Please also check the contents and cooking instructions separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 開けられても調理不要とは限らないのですね。加熱はできるので表示を読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開封可能と調理不要は別と理解し加熱できるので調理表示を読むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: So being able to open it does not necessarily mean it needs no cooking. I can heat it, so I will read the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you understand being able to open it is different from not needing to cook it, and that you can heat it and will read the cooking instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。包装の開け方と食べる前の扱いを分けて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please check how to open the packaging separately from how to handle the contents before eating.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この袋の商品にします。切り口で開け、調理表示に従います。缶は今日は買いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切り口で開ける袋商品を選び調理表示に従い缶購入を見送ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take this product in a pouch. I will open it at the notch and follow the cooking instructions. I will not buy the can today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will choose the pouch product that opens at the notch, follow the cooking instructions, and leave the can for today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。缶はこちらで戻します。袋の商品をレジへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. I will put the can back. Please take the pouch product to the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園でお手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything I can help you with in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 幼い子とボールを転がしたいです。ボール遊びの看板がある広場へ行ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 幼児とボールを転がすためボール遊び表示の広場を利用できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to roll a ball with a little child. May we go to the open area with the ball games sign?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may use the open area marked for ball games to roll a ball with a toddler.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: あちらは今、年長のお子さんが投げ合っています。お子さんは歩き始めたくらいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Older children are throwing balls to one another there at the moment. Has your child only just started walking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。強い球が飛んでくると怖いので、同じ広場の端なら安全かと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 歩き始めた子が強い球を怖がるため広場の端の安全性を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Fast balls coming toward us would be frightening, so I thought the edge of the same area might be safe.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your child has just started walking and is frightened by fast balls, and ask about the safety of the edge of the open area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 端でも球が飛ぶことがあります。この場面では隣の小区画で転がす遊びができます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Balls can fly toward the edge too. In this situation, you can play by rolling a ball in the small area next to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その小区画にします。荷物を置いても子どもから離れずに見ていられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内された小区画を選び荷物を置いて子どもを見守れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We will use that small area. Is there somewhere I can put our things and watch my child without moving away?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will use the small area suggested, and ask whether you can put your things down and keep watching your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 区画の入口横に腰掛けがあります。ただし荷物で入口を塞がないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a seat beside the entrance to the area. Please make sure your belongings do not block the entrance, though.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 大きな敷物は広げず、バッグを足元に置きます。他の親子が来たら場所を分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 敷物を広げずバッグを足元に置き他の親子と場所を分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not spread out a large mat; I will put my bag by my feet. If other parents and children come, we will share the space.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will keep your bag by your feet without spreading out a mat, and share the space with other parents and children.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 小区画では投げ上げず、足元で転がしてください。通路へ出たボールは周りを見てから拾いましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: In the small area, please roll the ball at ground level rather than throwing it up. If it goes onto the path, check your surroundings before picking it up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 投げる広場は避けて小区画で転がします。通路に出たら子どもを連れて急に追いかけません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 小区画で転がす遊びをし通路の球を子どもと急に追わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will stay away from the area where balls are being thrown and roll ours in the small area. If it goes onto the path, I will not suddenly rush after it with my child.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will roll the ball in the small area and will not suddenly chase a ball on the path with your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。周りに気を付けて楽しんでください。また何かあればお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please enjoy yourselves and watch out for others. Let me know if you need anything else.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 機材のケースが大きいのですが、乗換先へエレベーターで運べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大型機材ケースをエレベーターで乗換先へ運べるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My equipment case is large. Can I take it by elevator to where I need to change trains?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can take a large equipment case by elevator to where you need to change trains.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ケースの幅を教えてください。扉を通るか係員が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the width of the case. A staff member will check whether it will fit through the door.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 幅は九十センチです。横に倒すと中の機材が壊れるので、立てたまま運びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 幅九十センチで機材保護のためケースを倒せないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is ninety centimeters wide. Laying it on its side would damage the equipment inside, so I would like to keep it upright while moving it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the case is ninety centimeters wide and cannot be laid on its side because the equipment needs to be protected.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この通路の扉では余裕がありません。無理に入れず、別の移動方法を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is not enough clearance at the door on this passage. Let us check another way to move it instead of forcing it through.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 次の列車に乗る予定でしたが、ケースを安全に運べる方法を優先します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予定列車よりケースを安全に運べる方法を優先すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was planning to take the next train, but I will put finding a safe way to move the case first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that finding a safe way to move the case takes priority over catching the planned train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 係員の確認には時間がかかります。発車に間に合わなければ後の便を相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: It will take time for a staff member to check. If you cannot make the departure, you can ask about a later service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、ここで待ちます。後の便でも予約した席が使えるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 係員を待ち後の便で予約席を使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will wait here. I would also like to ask whether I can use my reserved seat on a later service.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will wait for the staff member and ask whether your reserved seat can be used on a later service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 席の変更は券の条件を確認してからです。今の券を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We need to check your ticket conditions before changing your seat. May I see your current ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この予約券です。ケースは動かさず、経路と席の変更を確認してから移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約券を示しケースを動かさず経路と席変更の確認を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here is my reservation ticket. I will keep the case where it is and wait until the route and seat change have been checked before moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will show your reservation ticket and leave the case where it is while waiting for the route and seat change to be checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 券を拝見して係員へ連絡します。案内までお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will look at the ticket and contact a staff member. Please wait for further instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。転入の記入でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having trouble filling in your move-in registration?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 誕生日の月と日を逆に書いたかもしれません。この欄を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転入申請の誕生日欄で月と日を逆に記入した疑いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I may have written the month and day of my birthday the wrong way round. I would like to check this field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you suspect you reversed the month and day in the date-of-birth field on your move-in registration form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの資料から写しましたか。お持ちの本人確認資料を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which document did you copy it from? Please show me the identification document you have with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 母国の資料には05/09とあり、五月九日と読んでしまいました。私の誕生日は九月五日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 母国資料の05/09を五月九日と読んだが本人の誕生日は九月五日と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The document from my home country says 05/09, and I read it as May ninth. My birthday is September fifth.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you read 05/09 on your home-country document as May ninth, but your actual birthday is September fifth.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その数字だけで順序を推測せず、本人確認資料の表記を担当と確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the notation on your identification document with the person in charge rather than guessing the order from those digits alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらの資料では九月五日です。申請書の五月九日を訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人確認資料の九月五日を示し申請用紙の誤記訂正を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: This document gives it as September fifth. I would like to correct May ninth on the application form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will show September fifth on your identification document and want the incorrect date on the application form corrected.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 訂正方法を担当へ確認します。下の来日年月欄も誕生日を写していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will ask the person in charge how to make the correction. Did you also copy your birthday into the year-and-month-of-arrival-in-Japan field below?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来日欄にも誕生日を書いてしまいました。来日は去年の四月で、別の日付です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 来日年月にも誕生日を誤記し実際の来日は昨年四月と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I wrote my birthday in the arrival field too. I came to Japan in April last year, so it is a different date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you mistakenly entered your birthday in the arrival-in-Japan year and month field too, and that you actually arrived in April last year.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二つの欄を分けて担当へ伝えます。現時点で書き足して重ねず、案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the person in charge about the two fields separately. Please wait for instructions without writing over the entries now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 誕生日は九月五日、来日は去年四月と分けます。資料を示して担当の訂正方法に従います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 誕生日と来日年月を分け本人資料で担当の訂正案内に従うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will distinguish my birthday, September fifth, from my arrival in Japan, April last year. I will show my documents and follow the person in charge's instructions for correcting them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will distinguish your birthday from the year and month of arrival in Japan, show your identification document, and follow the correction instructions from the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本人確認資料と用紙をお持ちになって担当へどうぞ。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your identification document and the form to the person in charge. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 十時の診察予約なので、家族に十時半に迎えを頼みました。終わる時間は合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十時予約に対し十時半の迎えを頼んだので診察終了見込みを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My medical appointment is at ten, so I asked my family to pick me up at ten thirty. Is that the right time for it to be finished?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese when your consultation is likely to finish, explaining that you arranged a ten-thirty pickup for your ten o'clock appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 十時は予約時刻で、終了時刻はまだ決まりません。診察内容によっても変わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ten o'clock is your appointment time; the finishing time is not known yet. It also depends on what the consultation involves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三十分で終わると自分で決めてしまいました。家族は車で待つ予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 診察三十分と自己判断して車の家族を待たせる予定にしたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I assumed on my own that it would be over in thirty minutes. My family is planning to wait in the car.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you assumed the consultation would take thirty minutes and arranged for your family to wait in the car.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 固定の迎え時刻にはせず、終了後に連絡できるか家族と相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please discuss with your family whether you can contact them after you finish instead of setting a fixed pickup time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうします。診察中に電話が来ると困るので、終わったら私から連絡すると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 診察中の着信を避け終了後に本人から連絡する段取りを家族へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will. I would not want a call during the consultation, so I will tell them I will contact them myself afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will arrange to contact your family yourself after the consultation to avoid receiving a call during it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その方法でご相談ください。診察後も会計などがある場合は、ご案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please discuss that arrangement with them. If there is payment or anything else after the consultation, please check the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 診察室を出た時点ですぐ帰れるとは限らないのですね。会計まで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診察室退出だけでは帰れないと理解し会計の案内も確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: So leaving the consultation room does not necessarily mean I can go straight home. I will check what I need to do through payment as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you understand you may not be able to leave immediately after exiting the consultation room, and that you will check the payment instructions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。帰る準備ができた時点でご連絡ください。車の待機場所は施設の案内で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please contact them once you are ready to leave. You can check the facility's instructions for where the car should wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族には時間未定と伝えました。会計などが終わって帰れる時に連絡し、案内された場所で合流します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族へ時刻未定を伝え帰宅準備完了後に連絡して指定場所で合流すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have told my family that the time is not yet known. I will contact them when payment and everything else are finished and I am ready to leave, and meet them at the place indicated.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have told your family the time is undecided, will contact them once you are ready to leave, and will meet them at the designated place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。予約票を確認して受付します。お席でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will check your appointment slip and register you. Please take a seat and wait.
